description: This file defines a custom exception class VueControllerException within the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the Core Controller Exception namespace. It provides an additional static method to generate a specific exception related to Vue controller handling scenarios.

classes.name: VueControllerException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending the base PHP Exception class, specific to Vue controller errors within OrangeHRM.

methods.name: alreadyHandled
methods.description: Static method that returns an instance of VueControllerException with a specific message indicating that the request has already been handled and the component cannot be changed.
